_comment: POLICY RECORD, not live config (#245). Claude Code loads hooks from
settings files with NO content verification, NO cross-session approval,
and live file-watching — so a checked-out branch that modified either
the hook scripts or a committed hooks block would execute silently.
The live wiring therefore resides in .claude/settings.local.json
(untracked, symlink-shared across worktrees), installed from this
template ONLY by a maintainer running ./scripts/pin-hooks.sh after
reviewing the diff. Every command verifies ALL hook scripts against
the local TOFU pin store (.claude/hooks.sha256, also untracked)
before executing — mismatch fails closed with a re-pin instruction.
Never re-add a hooks block to the committed .claude/settings.json.

hooks.command: sh -c 'shasum -a 256 -c .claude/hooks.sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "BLOCKED: .claude/hooks/* does not match the local TOFU pins (.claude/hooks.sha256). If you just checked out or pulled a branch, REVIEW the hook diffs, then re-pin: ./scripts/pin-hooks.sh (#245)" >&2; exit 2; }; exec .claude/hooks/format-python.sh'

If you just checked out or pulled a branch, REVIEW the hook diffs, then re-pin: ./scripts/pin-hooks.sh (#245)" >&2; exit 2; }; exec .claude/hooks/validate-manifest.sh'

If you just checked out or pulled a branch, REVIEW the hook diffs, then re-pin: ./scripts/pin-hooks.sh (#245)" >&2; exit 2; }; exec .claude/hooks/guard-main-branch.sh'

If you just checked out or pulled a branch, REVIEW the hook diffs, then re-pin: ./scripts/pin-hooks.sh (#245)" >&2; exit 2; }; exec .claude/hooks/inject-branch-context.sh'
